title: 3DS XL Pokeball
author: nitrous
description:
Pokéball themed protective case for the new Nintendo 3DS XL

This turns your old 3DS into a real life Pokéball

The project includes two different options for the center button to suit your preference:

1. **The "Flush" Look (Main Plate):** The main shell includes an inset button design. This is perfect for a sleek, low-profile feel that won't snag when sliding the DS into a pocket. Ready to go with just one print.
2. **The "Realistic" Look (Optional Plate):** In the 3MF I have included a **second print plate** with a separate, glueable button attachment. This gives the case a raised look (as seen in the cover photo) for extra realism.
